title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of Balance Ranges and Tier Entry Conditions
content:
The six tiers of Linden Ridge Medical Group's Patient Payment Plans each accept a defined band of enrolled balance and each carries its own entry conditions. This schedule states those figures for every tier.

## Schedule A: enrolled balance band

The smallest total balance a tier may enroll, and the largest total balance it may carry including any add-ons, in US dollars:

| Tier | Smallest enrolled balance | Largest balance carried (add-ons included) |
|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | 150.00 | 1,000.00 (1000.00) |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | 300.00 | 2,500.00 (2500.00) |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | 600.00 | 5,000.00 (5000.00) |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | 1,500.00 (1500.00) | 10,000.00 (10000.00) |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | 2,500.00 (2500.00) | 20,000.00 (20000.00) |
| Financial Hardship Plan | 200.00 | 20,000.00 (20000.00) |

## Schedule B: entry conditions by tier

| Tier | Current financial-hardship approval on the billing account required | Prior-default lockout (calendar months) | Balances already placed with the collection agency may be enrolled |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | No |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | No |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 12 | Yes |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | No | 24 | Yes |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | No | 24 | Yes |
| Financial Hardship Plan | Yes | 0 | Yes |

Notes to Schedule B:

1. The prior-default lockout is the number of calendar months after a previous plan's default during which the tier is not offered; a lockout of 0 means the tier has no lockout.
2. Where a tier accepts balances already placed with the collection agency, enrolling such a balance recalls the placement.

## Schedule C: summary of the entry gate of each tier

| Tier | Entry gate recorded for the tier |
|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | Enrolled balance from 150.00 to 1,000.00 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | Enrolled balance from 300.00 to 2,500.00 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | Enrolled balance from 600.00 to 5,000.00; automatic debit enrolled; no default within 12 months |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | Enrolled balance from 1,500.00 to 10,000.00; automatic debit enrolled; counselor-reviewed; no default within 24 months |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | Enrolled balance from 2,500.00 to 20,000.00; automatic debit enrolled; counselor-reviewed; no default within 24 months |
| Financial Hardship Plan | Current hardship approval; counselor-reviewed; enrolled balance of at least 200.00 |

## Reading the schedule

**Which tier bands overlap?** Several bands overlap. A hypothetical enrolled total of 800.00, for instance, lies inside the bands of the 3-Month, 6-Month and 12-Month Interest-Free Plans and of the Financial Hardship Plan; it lies below the smallest enrolled balance of the 18-Month and 24-Month Extended Plans.

**Is the top of a band part of the band?** Schedule A gives the smallest and the largest figure a tier accepts; a hypothetical total of exactly 1,000.00 is the largest balance the 3-Month Interest-Free Plan carries and is inside its band, while 1,000.01 is outside it.

**Which tiers carry no lockout?** The 3-Month Interest-Free Plan, the 6-Month Interest-Free Plan and the Financial Hardship Plan each show a lockout of 0.
